title: The messages that do not wait for you
target: How the readouts and messages in R.E.P.O. appear and disappear, so a number that vanished can be told apart from one that never arrived.
version: 0.4.0, read from the copy of the game this site was built from (see the sources page)
prerequisites: More than one thing happening at once

steps.do: Know that the readouts share a base rather than each being built separately.
steps.because: the readouts share a base with a text, a transform, a show position and a hide position (SemiUI, uiText, textRectTransform, showPosition, hidePosition)

steps.do: Expect a readout to have a place it comes from and a place it goes to.
steps.because: each has a show position and a hide position rather than appearing in place (showPosition, hidePosition)

steps.do: Read it while it is there, because each has a hide timer of its own.
steps.because: each has a default hide timer and a hidden flag (defaultHideTimer, isHidden)

steps.do: Watch the shrink rather than the disappearance, because leaving is animated.
steps.because: they shrink on an animation curve and raise an event when the shrink completes (animationCurveShrink, shrinkComplete)

steps.do: Expect some messages to animate the whole object and not only the text.
steps.because: they can animate the whole object rather than only the text (animateTheEntireObject)

steps.do: Know that some readouts are kept from being switched off.
steps.because: they can be kept from being disabled (doNotDisable)

steps.do: Know which fixed readout answers what, because not everything fades.
steps.because: health, the haul, the goal and item details each have a readout of their own under one state readout (HUD, HealthUI, HaulUI, GoalUI, ItemInfoUI)

steps.do: Look for the second item readout when the first is not enough.
steps.because: item details have a second readout for extra information (ItemInfoExtraUI)

commonMistakes: Missing a message that had a hide timer and was gone before you looked.
Reading a shrink as a miss rather than as the readout leaving.
Waiting for a fixed readout to disappear when it is kept on purpose.
Reading only the first line of item detail.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
